claim: Cost of goods is what sold, and concentration reads the till (ADR 0298; findings A-046, A-018, AW16). AnalyticsService reads the till through `.rpc("pos_item_sales"`, and its `const cogs =` statement multiplies `bottlesOut` by the recorded cost, names no `orders` (e2cbe426a summed DELIVERED procurement_orders, analytics.service.ts:428) and is null when `soldRows.length === 0` (a till that moved no stock has no cost to read; the first build printed 0 and a 100% margin). `const skuRevenue =` weighs `weighed` and no `unitPrice` (e2cbe426a weighed menu price x bottles on hand, :725-726), and `const weighed =` keeps an unsold item only when `s.mapped` and `activeIds.has` it, so an active row no POS mapping points at is not a 0 weight (the first build weighed every active row; Tuzlu's 18 unmapped menu rows, A-013, would lift the truth 0.565 to about 0.62). The newest migration that defines public.pos_item_sales returns `'mapped', p.mapped` from `FROM public.pos_item_mappings`, keeps it SECURITY INVOKER and revokes it from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated. METRIC_REGISTRY's revenue_max_drawdown says `computed: false` (it was one of 33 entries all marked true; seven are false now). Measured 2026-10-04 on fix/cost-and-revenue-from-the-pos after the round-1 fixes: this verify fails at e2cbe426a and at 0c46277cd (the first build: nomove, skuRevenue, weighed and mapped fail) and holds on the branch, and each of nine single mutations makes it fail (see the commit body).
